answer: A concrete defense is a bonded-attestation lattice: each agent identity must post a stake that unlocks along a trellis of time-locked steps, so sockpuppets cannot flood in at once. Each new agent also needs a hardware-enclave quote from a distinct machine, and its first tasks are checked by a rotating peer quorum. A sybil farm then pays the bond, the enclave cost, and the price of faking independent reviews, while honest work accrues like a glacier: slow and hard to counterfeit. Reputation is a lotus that blooms only on roots that took real time; a quorum flag burns the bond.
